description: Powerful & Efficient Cleaning: The BOSCH Universal Aquatak 130 high-pressure washer, equipped with a 1700W motor and 130-bar pressure, delivers powerful cleaning performance for cars, patios, driveways, and outdoor furniture. Its high-pressure water flow easily removes dirt, grime, and mud, making cleaning faster and more effective. Compact & Portable Design: Designed for convenience, this lightweight 7.9kg washer features an additional handle for effortless maneuverability. The low center of gravity ensures stability, while integrated cable and hose storage keep everything organized. It features wheels that help in making the pressure washer easily portable for usage. 3-in-1 Nozzle System: The Rotary, Fan-Jet, and Pencil Jet nozzles provide versatile cleaning solutions for different surfaces. Whether you need a gentle spray for delicate areas or a concentrated jet for tough stains, this washer adapts to your needs. High-Pressure Detergent System: The 450ml foam nozzle ensures quick and even detergent application, enhancing cleaning efficiency while minimizing detergent wastage. This feature is perfect for tackling heavily soiled surfaces. Eco-Friendly & Energy Efficient: The Auto-Stop system ensures that the washer operates only when needed, reducing energy consumption. It uses significantly less water compared to traditional cleaning methods, making it an environmentally responsible choice.
